cases.proves_bugs: BUG-655 (Edit Pipe route at a pit with two pipes arriving: the outlet follows the lowest one and the warning names it)
cases.title: Two pipes arrive at P83; Edit Pipe raises one of them 200 mm and Recalculate downstream keeps the outgoing pipe under the lower one, and says so
cases.plan_item: Bug-proof plan wave 1 (BUG_PROOF_PLAN_31OCT.md), group E: Edit Pipe 'Recalculate downstream' at a junction
cases.expected: Four pits P81 to P84 and three pipes (P81->P83 18.050 / 17.950, P82->P83 18.000 / 17.900, P83->P84 17.880 / 17.780), no Grade mismatch window. Edit Pipe on P81->P83 with 18.25 / 18.15, Save, Recalculate Yes, Cascade Preview Apply: the command line says 'Warning: Pit P83: pipe P82 -> P83 arrives at 17.90, lower than the 18.15 this change brings, so the pipe leaving the pit follows the lower level.' and 'Updated 1 pipes and 1 pits from P83 (IL 18.15)'. P83->P84 reads IL 17.88 and IL 17.78; no text reads IL 18.05 and only one text reads IL 18.15 (the edited pipe's). No CE window is left open; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: PropagationCascadeHuntTests prove the walk on a made-up graph; only the live drawing shows that Edit Pipe hands the walk the edited pipe and its level from before the save, that both arriving pipes reach the walk with their drawn levels, and that the warning and the texts follow.
not_automated: CDPROPAGATE and the batch 'Carry downstream' are not driven. A junction reached by two changed pipes at once (REGRESSION_LOG BUG-652..655 item 9, 'not ordered') is not driven.
The preview window's own wording is recorded only. Pit P84's schedule level (17.78) is not read.
DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: every line and level above; that P82 -> P83 is the label the walk builds (BuildPipeLabel, line 707-712, pit numbers from the drawing as 'from P3' in R11).
